data.title: CareScout Focuses Strategic Direction on Aging Care Services
data.description:
CareScout Focuses Strategic Direction on Aging Care Services

CareScout today announced a singular focus on its aging care services business and plans to discontinue new insurance sales through CareScout Insurance Company in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

The decision reflects CareScout’s belief that its services business offers the greatest opportunity to help millions of families navigate aging care for their loved ones and create long-term value for Genworth shareholders.

“We set out to make the aging journey more confident, connected, and clear, and that ambition has not changed,” said Samir Shah, CEO of CareScout. “We are choosing to focus our investment on a capital-light services business where we see the greatest opportunity for growth and long-term value creation. Together with our partners, we can help more families plan for and manage the care of aging loved ones as their needs evolve.”

CareScout brings together cost-of-care insights, care expertise, personalized guidance, and access to quality care to help families understand their needs, explore their options, and take the next steps with confidence. Building on these capabilities, the company will work with insurers, employers, advisors, and care providers to reach more families and broaden its services across the aging journey.

Existing CareScout Insurance policies remain in force with no change to servicing contacts or processes, and CareScout Insurance Company remains committed to meeting all contractual obligations. The decision is not expected to have a material impact on Genworth’s financial condition or results of operations.

About CareScout
CareScout helps older adults and their families navigate the aging journey, find, and fund quality care. Inspired by a mission to simplify and dignify the aging experience, we're building an integrated ecosystem of care and funding solutions. To learn more about CareScout, visit www.CareScout.com. CareScout is a wholly owned subsidiary of Genworth Financial, Inc. (NYSE: GNW). CareScout is the marketing name for CareScout Holdings, Inc., its affiliates and entities. Affiliates and entities are solely and separately responsible for their own financial and contractual obligations.

data.title: San Francisco Proclaims Fromm Day as the Fromm Institute Turns 50
data.description:
San Francisco Proclaims Fromm Day as the Fromm Institute Turns 50

San Francisco Proclaims Fromm Day as the Fromm Institute Turns 50

PR Newswire

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 19, 2026

More than 960 students enrolled at the Fromm Institute this fall. In a student survey, 63 percent of respondents said they felt less isolated.

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On her lunchtime walks through the University of San Francisco in 2012, Max Ferman kept seeing the same groups of older adults talking and laughing as they walked from Fromm Hall to the University Center. They disappeared in the summer and came back in the fall. "Who were these happy old people!?" she recalled wondering.

 San Francisco proclaimed Nov. 14 Fromm Day as the Fromm Institute marked 50 years of lifelong learning.

Ferman became a Fromm student in 2022 and shared that story on behalf of her fellow students at the Fromm Institute for Lifelong Learning's 50th anniversary gala on Nov. 14, 2026. Students, faculty, university leaders and supporters gathered at the McLaren Center, where the Institute received a proclamation from Mayor Daniel Lurie Office declaring Nov. 14 Fromm Day in San Francisco.

Fern Warner attended the Institute's first session in 1976 and still takes classes today. Betty Dvorson, who is about to turn 101, keeps coming to class because learning makes her happy. In a Fromm Institute student survey, 82 percent of respondents reported greater life satisfaction, 63 percent said they felt less isolated and 52 percent reported forming new social networks.

Executive Director Derek Leighnor described how those relationships take shape. A conversation that starts in class can turn into a standing lunch date or a friendship that lasts for years. When the pandemic closed classrooms in 2020, Fromm students learned to meet online so they could keep studying together and stay connected.

University of San Francisco President Salvador D. Aceves invited guests to picture an 18-year-old undergraduate heading to a first-year seminar while a 90-year-old Fromm student walked to class. Hanna and Alfred Fromm's founding vision, he said, broadened whom the university could serve and gave younger and older students a chance to learn from one another.

Rabbi Brian Lurie, chair of the Friends of the Fromm Institute Board of Directors, thanked university leaders, the board and Leighnor for sustaining the Institute.

Hanna Fromm expected about 50 people at the first open house. About 150 enrolled in the first year. This fall, more than 960 enrolled. Fifty years after that first open house, Fromm students are introducing more San Franciscans to the program at neighborhood farmers markets.

Enrollment is now open for the Fromm Institute's Winter session, which begins Jan. 11, 2027. Adults 50 and older can explore courses and enroll.

About the Fromm Institute for Lifelong Learning

Founded in 1976 at the University of San Francisco, the Fromm Institute offers daytime courses for adults 50 and older, on campus and online. Students explore art, history, literature, science and other subjects without grades, exams or homework. fromminstitute.org

data.title: Intuit Selling Mailchimp for $3.68 Billion to Berkshire Hathaway-Backed Bending Spoons — Update
data.description:
By Katherine Hamilton

Intuit has agreed to sell its email automation platform Mailchimp for $3.68 billion to Bending Spoons, the owner of several wayward tech brands that recently attracted a major investment from Berkshire Hathaway.

The purchase price includes $3.31 billion in cash and $368 million in Bending Spoons stock.

The deal comes about a month after Bending Spoons revealed that Berkshire Hathaway had invested about $930 million in the company, accumulating a 4% stake. The Milan-based company said at the time the investment would provide fresh funds to pursue additional acquisitions.

Mailchimp joins an eclectic stable of digital brands Bending Spoons owns including AOL, Everbrite, Evernote, Vimeo and others. Bending Spoons Chief Executive Luca Ferrari said his company, which went public in July, plans to invest substantially in Mailchimp once the deal closes.

Intuit said selling Mailchimp would allow it to focus on its core products, including Quickbooks, Credit Karma and TurboTax, where it is implementing more AI features. The company plans to use cash proceeds to buy back shares during fiscal 2027.

"It's better for our focus, better for our capital allocation," Chief Executive Sasan Goodarzi said on a call with investors.

The deal, which is expected to close early in 2027, came as both companies released their quarterly earnings.

Intuit reported a higher profit as revenue rose 12% to $4.35 billion in its fiscal first quarter, with results topping analyst estimates. Sales in Intuit's business-facing segment increased 15%, while its consumer-facing sales rose 7%.

Mailchimp's revenue declined 1% to $313 million in the quarter.

For the full year, Intuit said it now expected revenue between $23.08 billion to $23.37 billion, down from its prior view for $23.28 billion to $23.51 billion. It expects earnings per share of $20.12 to $20.36.

For the current second quarter, Intuit projected revenue of $4.93 billion to $4.95 billion, with earnings per share between $2.55 and $2.60. Both projections were below analysts' estimates of $5.11 billion in sales and $3.73 a share in earnings.

Bending Spoons, meanwhile, raised its outlook for the year, after reporting higher profit and revenue in the third quarter.

Shares of Intuit fell almost 10% in late trading to $297.25, while shares of Bending Spoons rose 4.3% to $43.50.

data.title: RADIN Health Unveils RADINA™, the Autonomous AI Ecosystem for Imaging, at RSNA 2026
data.description:
RADIN Health Unveils RADINA™, the Autonomous AI Ecosystem for Imaging, at RSNA 2026

RADIN Health Unveils RADINA™, the Autonomous AI Ecosystem for Imaging, at RSNA 2026

PR Newswire

SHERIDAN, Wyo., Nov. 19, 2026

One autonomous AI platform guiding every patient from referral to follow-up, automating repetitive work, connecting workflows, and helping imaging organizations scale without adding administrative complexity.

SHERIDAN, Wyo., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RADIN Health today announced RADINA, a next-generation AI platform designed to automate and orchestrate imaging workflows across the entire patient journey. Scheduled to be officially unveiled at RSNA 2026, RADINA serves as the AI layer behind RADIN™, connecting operational, clinical, and patient-facing workflows into a single intelligent ecosystem.

Imaging organizations face continued pressure from workforce shortages, rising labor costs, increasing patient volumes, reimbursement cuts, and growing compliance requirements. While healthcare software has digitized many imaging processes, organizations still rely heavily on staff to coordinate referrals, insurance verification, prior authorizations, scheduling, patient communications, reporting workflows, and follow-up management.

"Healthcare doesn't need more dashboards, more queues, or more disconnected applications," said Dr. Alejandro Bugnone, Chief Executive Officer of RADIN Health. "It needs systems that understand what should happen next and can make it happen. RADINA was built to automate repetitive work, eliminate unnecessary handoffs, and help imaging organizations scale without increasing administrative complexity."

Unlike traditional workflow tools that automate individual tasks, RADINA continuously evaluates the state of each patient's journey and determines the next action required to move care forward. The platform follows patients from referral intake through scheduling, authorization, imaging, reporting, and follow-up management while escalating exceptions to staff when human judgment is required.

RADINA moves beyond traditional workflow automation by coordinating the next best action across the imaging journey and executing routine operational tasks from referral intake through follow-up. The platform was built around a simple principle: "If the system knows what has to happen next, nobody should have to remember it."

Experience the Official RADINA Launch at RSNA 2026

RSNA attendees are invited to visit RADIN Health Booth #5515 for the official launch of RADINA™ on Sunday, November 29 at 10:40 AM. Visitors will have the opportunity to meet the RADINA Concierge robot, an AI-powered digital front desk that greets patients, automates check-in, supports registration workflows, and can escort patients to their destination within an imaging center. Available as a mobile robotic assistant, self-service kiosk or tablet, RADINA Concierge demonstrates how imaging organizations can modernize patient access while reducing administrative burden and improving operational efficiency. 

RSNA 2026 attendees can also experience live demonstrations of RADINA at the RADIN Health exhibit booth #5515. Dr. Alejandro Bugnone is scheduled to speak at RSNA on Guiding the Referral-to-Follow-Up Patient Journey on November 30 from 1:00 PM to 1:20 PM at Innovation Theater, Booth 3352, and on Agentic AI with Clinical Oversight on December 1 from 12:00 PM to 12:20 PM at AI Theater, Booth 5536.

RADINA Autopilot™ - The Autonomous Imaging Workflow Engine

At the center of the platform is RADINA Autopilot™, an autonomous workflow engine that connects imaging operations into a single continuous workflow. Autopilot manages each patient's progression through the imaging process and automatically initiates the next appropriate step. It runs the entire referral-to-follow-up cycle as one workflow while engaging staff only when decisions require human oversight.

RADINA Autopilot can:

  • Process incoming referrals and orders
  • Verify insurance eligibility and medical necessity
  • Manage scheduling workflows
  • Coordinate prior authorizations
  • Engage patients through voice, chat, and digital communications
  • Send forms, perform digital check-in, and collect patient payments
  • Monitor report quality and compliance
  • Track completion of radiologist report imaging follow-up recommendations

According to RADIN Health, imaging organizations spend significant administrative time moving patients from referral to completed exam. RADINA is designed to reduce manual effort by automating routine tasks and allowing staff to focus on exceptions, patient support, and clinical coordination.

A Connected AI Ecosystem

RADINA includes AI-powered products and capabilities spanning imaging operations, radiologist productivity, quality assurance, compliance, and revenue optimization. The platform operates as a unified intelligence layer across the imaging enterprise, following the patient from referral through follow-up. 

Before the Exam

  • OCR for orders and referrals
  • Insurance verification and medical necessity validation
  • Intelligent appointment scheduling
  • Conversational patient scheduling
  • Prior authorization automation
  • Digital payment collection
  • Autonomous patient check-in

Quality, Compliance, and Revenue

  • Report quality review
  • Documentation compliance validation
  • Follow-up recommendation tracking
  • Closed-loop patient follow-up management

"RADINA represents a new generation of technology that doesn't just document work, it helps perform it," said Dipali Lohar, Chief Product Officer of RADIN Health.

The platform maintains a single workflow and timeline for every patient, enabling organizations to reduce administrative friction, minimize missed steps, improve patient engagement, and ensure follow-up recommendations are completed.

About RADIN Health

RADIN is a comprehensive cloud-native platform and intelligent workflow ecosystem for radiology and diagnostic imaging organizations. Its technology unifies enterprise imaging, RIS, PACS, SELECT workflow orchestration, dictation, intelligent worklists, clinical communications, patient engagement, analytics, compliance, and AI-powered automation within a single connected environment. Designed for hospitals, imaging centers, radiology groups, and teleradiology practices, RADIN helps healthcare organizations improve operational efficiency, clinical quality, patient access, financial performance, scalability, and care coordination across the entire imaging journey, from referral to follow-up.

For more information, visit www.radinhealth.com.

CLOUD-NATIVE INTELLIGENT IMAGING ECOSYSTEM

data.title: CORRECTING and REPLACING IMAX and Showcase Cinemas Strike Agreement for 13 New IMAX With Laser Locations Across the United Kingdom and Europe
data.description:
CORRECTING and REPLACING IMAX and Showcase Cinemas Strike Agreement for 13 New IMAX With Laser Locations Across the United Kingdom and Europe

Under New Leadership Following its Acquisition this Month, Showcase Cinemas Signs Biggest Agreement Ever for New IMAX Systems in the UK

Fourth paragraph, first sentence of release should read: The agreement marks Showcase Cinema UK’s first investment following its acquisition from Harbor Lights Entertainment, Inc. led by Greidinger, who has been in business with IMAX for nearly 30 years. (instead of The agreement marks Showcase Cinema UK’s first investment following its acquisition from Skydance led by Greidinger, who has been in business with IMAX for nearly 30 years.)

The updated release reads:

IMAX AND SHOWCASE CINEMAS STRIKE AGREEMENT FOR 13 NEW IMAX WITH LASER LOCATIONS ACROSS THE UNITED KINGDOM AND EUROPE

Under New Leadership Following its Acquisition this Month, Showcase Cinemas Signs Biggest Agreement Ever for New IMAX Systems in the UK

IMAX Corporation (NYSE: IMAX) and Showcase Cinemas today announced an agreement for 13 new state-of-the-art IMAX® with Laser system, including 12 locations in the United Kingdom and one additional European location. The agreement — which marks the single largest agreement ever for new IMAX locations in the UK — reignites the partnership between IMAX and Showcase Cinemas, following its acquisition this month led by former Cineworld Group CEO and longstanding IMAX supporter Mooky Greidinger.

“I’ve been in the IMAX business for decades and the value of its technology, brand, and strategic partnership to exhibitors have grown exponentially in that time,” said Greidinger. “There is no doubt that IMAX plays a significant role in the results of the industry and I am sure it will continue to grow and attract new audience and become even more significant in the coming years. I look forward to working with Rich and his team and making the IMAX Experience a cornerstone of the new Showcase Cinemas in the UK.”

“Mooky is a visionary leader and an excellent partner who recognized the value in IMAX long before our recent run of record-breaking success — we’re excited to be back in business with his team at Showcase Cinemas UK,” said Rich Gelfond, CEO of IMAX. “This agreement significantly expands our footprint in one of our most successful markets, and underscores the strong opportunity for network growth as we deliver our best year ever at the global box office.”

The agreement marks Showcase Cinema UK’s first investment following its acquisition from Harbor Lights Entertainment, Inc. led by Greidinger, who has been in business with IMAX for nearly 30 years. Five of the new IMAX locations, spread across England, will open in 2027, with the remaining balance opening over the next few years.

IMAX has seen incredible momentum in the United Kingdom, with roughly $70 million in box office across 2026 to date, good for the highest grossing year ever for IMAX in the market. The new pact marks the latest in IMAX’s global network expansion, with several more potential large-scale deals under review.

The momentum is underscored by IMAX’s biggest release ever, The Odyssey, which has collected over $550 million in IMAX global box office to date, representing roughly 30% of the films total result. IMAX has an incredibly strong film slate through the rest of the year, capped off by the debut of Skydance/Legendary’s Dune: Part Three, which hits IMAX locations worldwide in December.

The new Showcase Cinemas IMAX locations in the UK will be equipped with IMAX with Laser, IMAX's most advanced cinema experience. Developed from the ground up for maximum immersion, IMAX with Laser delivers crystal-clear 4K images, precision audio, and state-of-the-art projection technology, setting a new standard for moviegoing. The system features a groundbreaking optical engine, custom-designed lenses, and proprietary IMAX technology that delivers brighter images, deeper contrast, and the widest range of colors exclusively to IMAX screens.

About IMAX Corporation

IMAX (NYSE: IMAX) is a global leader in entertainment technology, delivering immersive cinematic experiences through proprietary software, architecture, and projection systems. Filmmakers, studios, and artists worldwide use IMAX to connect with audiences at scale, making its network one of the most powerful platforms for blockbuster events and entertainment.

Headquartered in New York, Toronto, and Los Angeles, IMAX operates 1,887 systems across 91 countries and territories as of September 30, 2026. IMAX China Holding, Inc., a subsidiary of IMAX Corporation, trades on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under stock code “1970.” IMAX and related marks are trademarks of IMAX Corporation. data.title: Highland Copper Reports Q1 2027 Financial and Operational Results
data.description:
VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Highland Copper Company Inc. (TSXV: HI; OTCQB: HDRSF) (“Highland” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce its financial and operational results for the three months ended September 30, 2026.

The Company’s unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and accompanying Management’s Discussion and Analysis (“MD&A”) for the period ended September 30, 2026 are available under the Company’s profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on the Company’s website at https://www.highlandcopper.com/investors/#financial-reports.

Q1 2027 Financial Highlights

  • Cash Position: Ended the quarter with $16.6 million in cash, compared to $18.9 million as of June 30, 2026.
  • Working Capital: Maintained positive working capital of $15.2 million as of September 30, 2026.
  • Net Loss: Recorded a net loss of $2.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 ($(0.00) per share) compared to net loss of $4.1 million during the comparative period last year ($(0.01) per share).

Selected Financial Results

The following table summarizes selected financial data for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025:


Q1 2027 Operational Highlights & Outlook

  • State Infrastructure Grant: The Company announced final approval by the Michigan Strategic Fund of $50 million in performance-based grant funding under the Strategic Site Readiness Program (“SSRP“) to support the development of the Company’s permitted Copperwood Project and related infrastructure improvements in Gogebic County, Michigan. The grant consists of:
    • US$45.0 million to Copperwood Resources Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Highland Copper, to support eligible infrastructure expenditures associated with the development of Copperwood; and
    • US$5.0 million to the Gogebic County Road Commission to support critical local infrastructure improvements associated with the Project and benefiting the broader region.
    • In addition to the SSRP funding, the Gogebic County Road Commission has secured a $7.5 million Transportation Economic Development Fund (“TEDF“) Category A grant from the Michigan Department of Transportation (“MDOT“).
    • Subsequent to quarter-end, Copperwood Resources Inc. concluded the formal grant agreement with the Michigan Strategic Fund. The grant is conditional upon the Company providing evidence, on or before March 31, 2028, that it has obtained commitments satisfactory to the MEDC for US$150,000,000 in additional project financing (the “Project Milestone”).  Once the Company demonstrates that it has met the Project Milestone, it will be eligible for reimbursement of expenditures made on or before March 31, 2033, on site preparation and improvement necessary to support the development of the Project. The grant is subject to certain completion milestones, including that the Company has established a minimum of 380 qualified jobs at the Project.
  • Wetland Delineation and Permitting: As disclosed in the Management's Discussion and Analysis for the year ended June 30, 2026, the Company initiated a wetland delineation survey to inform whether a supplemental permit may be appropriate before construction. Given the passage of time since the original wetland delineation and permit, it was considered prudent to determine if new wetland had emerged that required permitting. Through this exercise, it was determined there is a modest amount of acreage that will require a supplemental Part 303 Wetland Protection permit. This is consistent with the assessment by Michigan's Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy. It is anticipated that the formal wetland delineation will conclude in Q2 2027 with a goal of receiving the permit by Q4 2027.
     
  • Environmental Stewardship and Site Work: Continued early site work and environmental mitigation activities, including stream and wetland mitigation, revegetation, corrective work, and ongoing monitoring and maintenance. The Company also completed an off-site bridge replacement on budget and on time as a stream mitigation project and is in process to establish a 717-acre wetland preservation area.
     
  • Integrated Mine Plan Review: Advanced the Integrated Mine Plan Review, including refinement of mine design criteria, mine design and production scheduling, geotechnical assumptions, infrastructure and equipment requirements, and operating cost estimates. The work is intended to optimize the Copperwood mine plan and establish an updated technical and cost basis for subsequent project engineering and the planned update to the Copperwood Feasibility Study.

Scientific and Technical Information

The scientific and technical information contained in this news release has been reviewed and approved by Trace Arlaud, a “Qualified Person” as defined under NI 43-101. Ms. Arlaud is a consultant to Highland Copper and serves as the Company’s Project Director.

About Highland Copper Company

Highland Copper Company Inc. is a Canadian company focused on exploring and developing copper project in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, U.S.A. The Company has 739,158,985 common shares issued and outstanding. Its common shares are listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "HI" and trade on the OTCQB Venture Market under symbol "HDRSF".

DHC Expands Its Presence at Ulta Beauty with Signature Japanese Skincare Collection in 400 Stores

MECHANICSBURG, Pa., Nov. 19, 2026

What You Should Know:

  • Retail Milestone: DHC introduces its first dedicated display at Ulta Beauty across 400 select stores nationwide.
  • New Product: Deep Cleansing Face Wash, launched November 1, joins the bestselling Deep Cleansing Oil.
  • Four-Step Routine: Five SKUs across a four-step routine offer double cleansing followed by facial and eye hydration.

MECHANICSBURG, Pa., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Japanese skincare brand DHC is expanding its presence at Ulta Beauty, with five SKUs from its Signature Collection now featured in a dedicated display within the retailer's prestige Global Beauty set across 400 select stores nationwide. The placement marks DHC's first dedicated display at Ulta Beauty.

At the center of the collection is DHC's bestselling Deep Cleansing Oil, a longtime favorite among beauty editors and skincare enthusiasts, known for dissolving makeup, sunscreen and excess oil while leaving skin soft and hydrated. Joining the collection is the new Deep Cleansing Face Wash, launched November 1, completing the brand's Japanese double cleansing ritual.

Rooted in Japanese skincare traditions, double cleansing begins with an oil-based cleanser to remove makeup and daily buildup, followed by a gentle face wash to remove remaining impurities. Formulated with hyaluronic acid and olive leaf extract, the new face wash leaves skin feeling refreshed and comfortably hydrated.

The Signature Collection features four skincare steps:

  1. Deep Cleansing Oil (6.7 oz, $31.50; 2.3 oz, $16.00): An olive oil-based cleanser that removes makeup, sunscreen and excess sebum.
  2. Deep Cleansing Face Wash (3.5 oz, $31.50): Gently removes remaining impurities while maintaining hydration and helping support the skin barrier.
  3. Extra Nighttime Moisture (1.5 oz, $39.00): Features squalane and hydrolyzed collagen to nourish and moisturize skin.
  4. Concentrated Eye Cream (0.7 oz, $37.00): Features sodium hyaluronate, cucumber and ginseng to hydrate and soothe the eye area.

"The double cleanse has been at the heart of Japanese skincare for generations," said Rosa Pensa, Senior Brand Director at DHC USA. "With our new Deep Cleansing Face Wash and our first dedicated display at Ulta Beauty, shoppers can now discover both steps together and experience the complete routine."

About DHC

Founded in Japan in 1972, DHC introduced skincare in 1980 with Olive Virgin Oil and established DHC USA in 1995. The brand combines Japanese beauty traditions, botanical ingredients and modern formulation science, with olive oil central to its skincare heritage. For more information, www.dhccare.com.

data.title: Energy Down, but not by Much, as Oil Flows in Focus — Energy Roundup
data.description:
Shares of energy companies fell, but not by as much as the broad market, as traders awaited signals on the outlook for Middle East exports.

U.S. diesel prices are likely to continue falling from record highs as refined products from the Persian Gulf return to the market and unsanctioned Russian diesel puts downward pressure on prices, U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said in an interview.

The International Energy Agency said prolonged disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz could substantially reduce the world's reliance on the waterway over the next decade as Middle Eastern producers develop alternative export routes.
